bridges.text: Короче говоря, jak by ti řekli chlapi v Ostravě—
bridges.vocal_cue: Snap immediately to crisp Czech first-syllable stress and short vowels.

bridges.text: A když teď odložíme kravaty a podíváme se přímo pod kapotu s klukama z vývoje—
bridges.vocal_cue: Drop half an octave, lean forearms onto the table, clip vowels immediately.

bridges.text: Und wenn wir das steife Protokoll kurz beiseitelassen und ehrlich wie im Wiener Beisl reden—
bridges.vocal_cue: Lean back 10 degrees, crooked grin, stretch vowels into Wiener Schmäh cadence.

bridges.text: Now if we take the boardroom slide deck off the table for a second and talk brass tacks—
bridges.vocal_cue: Relax shoulders, accomplice half-smirk, punch monosyllabic verbs.

bridges.text: Y si dejamos ahora el protocolo de sala de juntas y hablamos en confianza como a pie de cancha—
bridges.vocal_cue: Lean forward warmly, sun-soaked pause before the Andaluz exclamation.

bridges.text: Ale když se na to podíváme pod kapotou...
bridges.vocal_cue: Drop half an octave, lean in as an engineering peer.
Slight crooked grin, stretch vowels into velvet Viennese candor.

bridges.text: A jak říkají kluci dole ve Vídni u kávy—
bridges.vocal_cue: Shift from clipped Czech first-syllable punch into stretched Viennese vowel drawl.

bridges.text: А если убрать официоз и сказать по-человечески, от души, как у нас в Алматы за дастарханом—
bridges.vocal_cue: Open chest resonance, warm palm gesture, slow tempo by 15%.

bridges.text: Aber weißt eh, как у нас в Алматы говорят от души—
bridges.vocal_cue: Drop from wry Viennese nasal irony into deep Almaty chest resonance.

bridges.text: Listen, bud—como decimos en el sur sin filtro—
bridges.vocal_cue: Pivot from gravel Foothills punch into rapid melodic Spanish burst.

vibe_links.target_term: mirar los toros desde la barrera
vibe_links.pivot_tip: Use an accomplice grin that frames bold action as the natural move.
Keep unstressed and conversational—signals immediate insider belonging.
Both carry grounded engineering respect—drop corporate adjectives and let the verb carry the weight.
Use the exact same downward vocal exhale on both phrases to signal "stiff shift is over, now we talk like humans."
Pause 1s before the noun so the deadpan irony lands cleanly.
Deliver with an unbothered wry grin contrasting glossy surface hype with real engine power.
Drop volume slightly to invite insider candor.

vibe_links.shared_root: Central European Salon / Boardroom Register-Drop Ritual
vibe_links.pivot_tip: Open palm gesture loosening formal stiffness before pivoting into peer candor.
Connect finesse in the saddle/paddock directly to clean technical execution.
Slow the tempo on the compliment so it feels earned, never flattering.
Lean in and drop half an octave when challenging safe incrementalism.

false_friends.meaning: Fresh / real-time ("čerstvá data" = live pipeline data)
One hour ("za hodinu") — critical for SLA commitments
Attention / watch out ("dávat pozor na" = achten auf)
Ridiculous / absurd (carries negative weight in B2B)
Amazing / impressive architecture ("Ten systém je úžasný")
Liquidate clearance stock — never use for B2B selling (use prodávat / vyjednat)
To forget (exact opposite of Russian запомнить!)

vocab_alert_nodes.meaning: Czech čerstvý = fresh (čerstvá data) ≠ Russian черствый = stale/hard
vocab_alert_nodes.warning: CRITICAL FALSE FRIEND: Czech "čerstvý" means fresh (e.g. čerstvá data), whereas Russian "черствый" means stale/hard bread.

vocab_alert_nodes.meaning: Czech dávat si pozor = exercise attention ≠ Russian позор = shame/disgrace
vocab_alert_nodes.warning: CRITICAL FALSE FRIEND: Czech "Dávat si pozor" means to exercise care/attention, whereas Russian "позор" means shame/disgrace.

vocab_alert_nodes.meaning: Czech úžasný = amazing/wonderful ≠ Russian ужасный = terrible/horrible
vocab_alert_nodes.warning: CRITICAL FALSE FRIEND: Czech "úžasný" means amazing/wonderful, whereas Russian "ужасный" means terrible/horrible.

songs.title: Vienna Calling
songs.original_lyric: Vienna Calling! Oida, die Zeit rennt davon. Kein Stress, der Schmäh rennt eh von allein, musst nur die Vorsicht an der Garderobe abgeben.
songs.translation_es: ¡Llamada desde Viena! Oida, el tiempo se nos va. Cero estrés, el encanto vienés fluye solo de todos modos, solo debes dejar la cautela en el ropero.
songs.translation_en: Vienna Calling! Oida, time is running out. No stress, the Schmäh runs by itself anyway, you just have to check your caution at the coat rack.
songs.translation_cz: Vídeň volá! Oida, čas utíká. Žádný stres, ten Schmäh stejně běží sám od sebe, jen musíš nechat opatrnost v šatně.
songs.translation_de: Vienna Calling! Oida, die Zeit rennt davon. Kein Stress, der Schmäh läuft sowieso von allein, du musst nur die Vorsicht an der Garderobe abgeben.
songs.translation_ru: Вена вызывает! Oida, время уходит. Никакого стресса, шме и так работает само по себе, надо только сдать осторожность в гардероб.
songs.cultural_vibe: Syncopated coffeehouse charm, theatrical detachment, status equalization
songs.pivot_line: Ich sehe, wie professionell Sie das aufgestellt haben... aber geh bitte: jetzt auf Nummer sicher gehen? Da musst du die übertriebene Vorsicht mal an der Garderobe abgeben, Oida!

songs.title: Ostrava
songs.original_lyric: Ostrava, Ostrava, město mezi městy, kaj ľudzie fchytaju šichtu a po robotě maju čistý fajront, bo ten motor pojede sám.
songs.translation_es: Ostrava, Ostrava, ciudad entre ciudades, donde la gente agarra el turno de trabajo y tras la labor tiene el fajront limpio, porque el motor funcionará solo.
songs.translation_en: Ostrava, Ostrava, city among cities, where people catch their shift and after work enjoy clean quitting time, because the engine will run by itself.
songs.translation_cz: Ostrava, Ostrava, město mezi městy, kde lidé chytají směnu a po práci mají čistý fajront, protože ten motor pojede sám.
songs.translation_de: Ostrava, Ostrava, Stadt unter Städten, wo die Leute ihre Schicht anpacken und nach der Arbeit sauberen Feierabend haben, weil der Motor von alleine läuft.
songs.translation_ru: Острава, Острава, город среди городов, где люди берутся за смену, а после работы у них чистый файронт, потому что этот мотор пойдёт сам.
songs.cultural_vibe: Industrial pride, miner grit, uncompromising short-vowel pace
songs.pivot_line: Sleduji vaše projekty a má to rozbor... ale upřímně, držet to teď při zemi je zbytečná šichta navíc. Když ten strach pustíš, máš čistý fajront, bo ten motor pojede sám.

songs.title: Working for the Weekend
songs.original_lyric: Everybody is working for the weekend, bud! Stop being all hat and no cattle, kick the garage door open and just give ’er!
songs.translation_es: ¡Todo el mundo trabaja para el fin de semana, viejo! Déjate de postureo sin sustancia, abre la puerta del garaje y ¡dale a todo trapo!
songs.translation_en: Everybody is working for the weekend, bud! Stop being all hat and no cattle, kick the garage door open and just give ’er!
songs.translation_cz: Všichni makají na víkend, kámo! Přestaň dělat ramena bez výsledků, otevři vrata garáže a prostě to roztaj na plný plyn!
songs.translation_de: Alle arbeiten fürs Wochenende, Kumpel! Hör auf mit der großen Klappe ohne Substanz, mach das Garagentor auf und gib einfach Vollgas!
songs.translation_ru: Все пашут ради выходных, старина! Хватит понтоваться без дела, выбивай ворота гаража и жми на всю катушку!
songs.cultural_vibe: Mechanical momentum, straight-shooting energy, zero corporate polish
songs.pivot_line: Hold on a second, bud—what you’ve got going here is the real deal. In a room full of people who are all hat and no cattle, if we kick the garage doors open tonight and just give ’er, where are we taking this thing first?

songs.title: Volando Voy
songs.original_lyric: Volando voy, volando vengo, por el camino yo me entretengo. Enamorao de la vida, porque esto tiene duende y no hay que mirar los toros desde la barrera.
songs.translation_es: Volando voy, volando vengo, por el camino yo me entretengo. Enamorao de la vida, porque esto tiene duende y no hay que mirar los toros desde la barrera.
songs.translation_en: Flying I go, flying I come, along the way I enjoy myself. In love with life, because this has true duende and you shouldn't watch the bulls from the sidelines.
songs.translation_cz: Létám sem a tam, cestou se bavím. Zamilovaný do života, bo to má skutočný duende a nemá smysl koukat na býky jen z bariéry.
songs.translation_de: Fliegend komme ich, fliegend gehe ich, unterwegs genieße ich das Leben. Verliebt ins Leben, weil das echten Duende hat und man die Stiere nicht von der Tribüne aus beobachten sollte.
songs.translation_ru: Лечу туда, лечу обратно, по дороге наслаждаюсь жизнью. Влюблённый в жизнь, потому что в этом есть настоящий дуэнде, и нечего смотреть на быков с трибуны.
songs.cultural_vibe: Sensory hyperbole, conspiratorial rhythm, unmanufacturable passion
songs.pivot_line: Oye, para el carro un segundo, tío: lo que transmites tiene duende. Eso no se fabrica ni se compra... ¡y ni de coña me digas que vas a mirar los toros desde la barrera!

songs.title: Джулия (Julia)
songs.original_lyric: Девочка моя Джулия, под тёплыми звёздами Алматы мы всё сделаем по красоте, базару нет, как за широким дастарханом.
songs.translation_es: Mi chica Julia, bajo las cálidas estrellas de Almaty lo haremos todo con pura belleza, sin duda alguna, como en un gran dastarhan.
songs.translation_en: My girl Julia, under the warm stars of Almaty we will do everything with absolute beauty, zero doubt, like at a wide dastarhan.
songs.translation_cz: Moje holka Julie, pod teplými hvězdami Almaty všechno uděláme po kráse, žádné pochyby, jako u širokého dastarhanu.
songs.translation_de: Mein Mädchen Julia, unter den warmen Sternen von Almaty machen wir alles in vollendeter Schönheit, ohne Zweifel, wie an einem großen Dastarhan.
songs.translation_ru: Девочка моя Джулия, под тёплыми звёздами Алматы мы всё сделаем по красоте, базару нет, как за широким дастарханом.
songs.cultural_vibe: Terrace warmth, Kazakhstani hospitality, soul-driven execution
songs.pivot_line: Слушай, родной, скажу как есть: то, что ты собрал — сделали по красоте. Базару нет, мы с тобой одной крови, давай поговорим по душам, как за широким дастарханом.

songs.title: One of the Girls
songs.original_lyric: Give me tough love, leave me with no breath... Push me down on my knees, tell me I belong to the world.
songs.translation_es: Dame amor duro, déjame sin aliento... Empújame de rodillas, dime que pertenezco al mundo.
songs.translation_en: Give me tough love, leave me with no breath... Push me down on my knees, tell me I belong to the world.
songs.translation_cz: Dej mi tvrdou lásku, nech mě bez dechu... Sraz mě na kolena, řekni mi, že patřím světu.
songs.translation_de: Gib mir harte Liebe, lass mich atemlos... Drück mich auf die Knie, sag mir, dass ich der Welt gehöre.
songs.translation_ru: Дай мне суровую любовь, оставь меня без дыхания... Поставь меня на колени, скажи, что я принадлежу миру.
songs.cultural_vibe: High-stakes nightlife intensity, intense devotion, chameleon surrender & velvet power dynamics
songs.pivot_line: Zero corporate polish... give me tough love and tell me I belong to the world. We’re both cut from that same late-night frequency: addicted to the rush, zero patience for the ordinary.

idiom.meaning: Having the subtle wrist touch and finesse to steer a high-speed situation effortlessly.
idiom.delivery: Subtle flick of the wrist, low conspiratorial Andaluz cadence.

idiom.meaning: Zero hollow flexing or status posturing—pure substance.
idiom.delivery: Calm chest voice, slight dismissive hand wave on "понтов".

card.text: Hele, nechceme tu s tímhle systémem fakt šahat, jasný? Chceme, aby to fachatovalo, bez kecání.
card.phonetics: ˈhɛlə, ˈnɛtʃməmː tuː sː tímːhɛlː sːýstɛmːɛmː fʌkt ˈʃaːt, jɑsːnɪ? ˈxʊmɛmː tɑj ˈfɑt͡ʃɑtʊləʊ, bɛz kɛtsænɪ.
card.english_gloss: Listen, we don't want to fuss over this system, you know? We want it to run smoothly, without any fuss.

idiom.meaning: To run smoothly, fire on all cylinders without babysitting
idiom.delivery: Short, sharp, delivered with a slight shrug of the shoulders

idiom.delivery: Short, declarative, with a slight shrug.
